text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Lunchtime at last~♪ Ehehe, thanks for the 
food~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One early afternoon. I spotted an 
Umamusume happily tucking into her meal.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big-senpai! Hey, hey, wanna grab some 
food together――

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! A-All of that right there... is milk?! 
Whoa, just how many cartons are there...?!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, milk is an absolute must with meals 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, dishes like simmered hijiki, 
dried sardines, and chilled tofu were laid 
out before her.
choice_data_list: That's a really nutritious menu, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Ehehe, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Calcium to strengthen your bones, and 
protein essential for body growth! Both 
packed to the brim!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
It's called the Big-san Special! Eat a 
whole bunch and grow super big~!
choice_data_list:
You really pay attention to your diet, 
huh!

You really pay close attention to your 
diet, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... As you can see, Big-san is still 
quite small.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*, *pant*...! Dammit, if only I'd 
secured a solid position back then...!"

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Losing out in positioning battles just 
because of physical build. Missing that 
last ounce of pure power. I've had so many 
frustrating moments like that――

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: ...Still!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
In that case, all I can do is work hard to 
grow big and strong!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't give up, you can make 
it BIG! Someday, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! As expected of Big-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, now I'm all fired up~...! I've 
gotta load up on tons of nutrition too!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Sounds great! Let's become big 
together, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Boo-chan, perfect timing! If you'd like, 
let's grab a meal together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If ya wanna get big and strong, you gotta 
eat hearty! Brian-san, you can get even 
bigger too!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Today's cafeteria menu had 
plenty of chicken dishes! I'll go fetch 
some for you!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Big-san, you've gotta eat plenty and build 
up your strength so you don't lose to 
Boo-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Power, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need any side veggies. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Yup! Ehehe, we're all gonna hit it big~♪
choice_data_list:
Let's keep growing big and strong like 
this.
To think Brian is here too...!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even if I'm still small right now, if 
I try my hardest, I know I can become one!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Body and soul! I'm gonna show you I can 
become mega big!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's admirable... Boo-chan 
wanting to grow even bigger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so! In that case, I'll bring 
you some other dishes too! Calcium is 
super important, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Just meat is fine.
